_comment: Flavour text for looking at things. Writers edit this file; no code changes required. Each key is a tile name from src/world/tiles.ts. Lines are picked with the seeded RNG so a given day reads the same twice.
DESK: A desk. Someone has labelled the stapler with their own name in marker.
Under the blotter: a 1994 wall planner, unmarked.
The drawer sticks. Inside, forty-one pens. Two of them work.
CUBICLE: Gray-blue fabric. If you press a pushpin in, it never comes out.
A partition. It stops sound the way a curtain stops weather.
Someone has stapled a cartoon here. It is about deadlines. It is not funny.
WALL: A wall, painted the colour of an old paperback.
There is a scuff here at exactly shoulder height, repeated all down the hall.
PRINTER: The laser printer. Amber light. It has been warming up since Tuesday.
PC LOAD LETTER, it says, to nobody, forever.
FAX: The fax machine. Dial 9 first. Everyone knows this. Nobody was told.
A curled thermal page in the tray, faded to blank. It may have been important.
COOLER: The water cooler. The social centre of the building and its listening post.
Glug. The bubble takes its time. So does everyone standing here.
RACK: Servers. Warm, loud, and administered by a man who does not return pages.
A handwritten label: DO NOT UNPLUG (THIS MEANS YOU, ACCOUNTING).
TABLE: A conference table seating twelve, booked until March.
Ring stains in a perfect arc, one per attendee, one per meeting.
PLANT: A ficus. Plastic, but dusted weekly by someone who knows that.
The leaves are shinier than anything else in the building.
DOORWAY: A doorway. The door itself was removed in an efficiency drive.
VINYL: Vinyl tile, waxed to a shine that makes the fluorescents worse.
CARPET: Industrial carpet. Speckled to hide coffee, and it does.
